ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_PaymentCardStatementSummary_ccd] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary
AS(SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode ORDER BY CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE DESC, Monthly_Daily ) RN, * FROM (
SELECT
CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
,CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
,CASE 
    WHEN CRDACCT_DTE_LST_STMT = 0  THEN CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar, CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN))
    ELSE CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar, CRDACCT_DTE_LST_STMT))
END AS PeriodStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate 
,CRDACCT_STMT_MIN_AMT_DUE  AS MinimumPaymentAmount
,NULL AS InterestRatePeriodInDays
,NULL AS PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays
,CASE
    WHEN CRDACCT_DTE_PYMT_DUE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
    ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, CRDACCT_DTE_PYMT_DUE)) 
END AS PaymentDueDate
,CRDACCT_STMT_CYC AS BillingCycleId
,CASE
    WHEN CRDACCT_DTE_LST_STMT = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
    ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, CRDACCT_DTE_LST_STMT)) 
END AS LastStatementDate
,CASE 
    WHEN CRDACCT_DTE_PRV_STMT = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
    ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, CRDACCT_DTE_PRV_STMT)) 
END AS LastPreviousStatementDate
,CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_RTL AS RetailStatementBalanceAmount
,CRDACCT_STMT_INT_RTL AS RetailStatementInterestAmount
,CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_CASH AS CashStatementBalanceAmount
,CRDACCT_STMT_INT_CASH AS CashStatementInterestAmount 
,CRDACCT_YTD_BP_STMT  AS YearToDateStatementBonusPoints
,CRDACCT_STMT_MIN_AMT_DUE AS StatementMinimumAmountDue
,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
,1 AS Monthly_Daily
FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
where BCC.CRDACCT_NBR IS NOT NULL
AND BCC.isLatest = '1'

UNION

SELECT
CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
,CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
,CASE 
    WHEN CRDACCT_DTE_LST_STMT = 0  THEN CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar, CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN))
    ELSE CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar, CRDACCT_DTE_LST_STMT))
END AS PeriodStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate 
,CRDACCT_STMT_MIN_AMT_DUE  AS MinimumPaymentAmount
,NULL AS InterestRatePeriodInDays
,NULL AS PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays
,CASE
    WHEN CRDACCT_DTE_PYMT_DUE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
    ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, CRDACCT_DTE_PYMT_DUE)) 
END AS PaymentDueDate
,CRDACCT_STMT_CYC AS BillingCycleId
,CASE
    WHEN CRDACCT_DTE_LST_STMT = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
    ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, CRDACCT_DTE_LST_STMT)) 
END AS LastStatementDate
,CASE 
    WHEN CRDACCT_DTE_PRV_STMT = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
    ELSE CONVERT(date, CONVERT(varchar, CRDACCT_DTE_PRV_STMT)) 
END AS LastPreviousStatementDate
,CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_RTL AS RetailStatementBalanceAmount
,CRDACCT_STMT_INT_RTL AS RetailStatementInterestAmount
,CRDACCT_STMT_BAL_CASH AS CashStatementBalanceAmount
,CRDACCT_STMT_INT_CASH AS CashStatementInterestAmount 
,CRDACCT_YTD_BP_STMT  AS YearToDateStatementBonusPoints
,CRDACCT_STMT_MIN_AMT_DUE AS StatementMinimumAmountDue
,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
,2 AS Monthly_Daily
FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
where BCC.CRDACCT_NBR IS NOT NULL 
AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
    )A
)



SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary WHERE RN =1;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH
TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(nvarchar,CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(datetime,PeriodStartDate)
,CONVERT(datetime,PeriodEndDate)
,CONVERT(int,BillingCycleId)
,CONVERT(numeric,MinimumPaymentAmount)
,CONVERT(int,InterestRatePeriodInDays)
,CONVERT(int,PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays)
,CONVERT(date,PaymentDueDate)
,CONVERT(date,LastStatementDate)
,CONVERT(date,LastPreviousStatementDate)
,CONVERT(numeric,RetailStatementBalanceAmount)
,CONVERT(numeric,RetailStatementInterestAmount)
,CONVERT(numeric,CashStatementBalanceAmount)
,CONVERT(numeric,CashStatementInterestAmount)
,CONVERT(numeric,YearToDateStatementBonusPoints)
,CONVERT(numeric,StatementMinimumAmountDue)
,CONVERT(nvarchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,CONVERT(varchar,SourceSystemCode)
,CONVERT(bigint,TaskRunId)
,CONVERT(bigint,WorkFlowId)
,CONVERT(datetime2,InsertDttm)
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(nvarchar,CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(datetime,PeriodStartDate)
,CONVERT(datetime,PeriodEndDate)
,CONVERT(int,BillingCycleId)
,CONVERT(numeric,MinimumPaymentAmount)
,CONVERT(int,InterestRatePeriodInDays)
,CONVERT(int,PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays)
,CONVERT(date,PaymentDueDate)
,CONVERT(date,LastStatementDate)
,CONVERT(date,LastPreviousStatementDate)
,CONVERT(numeric,RetailStatementBalanceAmount)
,CONVERT(numeric,RetailStatementInterestAmount)
,CONVERT(numeric,CashStatementBalanceAmount)
,CONVERT(numeric,CashStatementInterestAmount)
,CONVERT(numeric,YearToDateStatementBonusPoints)
,CONVERT(numeric,StatementMinimumAmountDue)
,CONVERT(nvarchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,CONVERT(varchar,SourceSystemCode)
,CONVERT(bigint,TaskRunId)
,CONVERT(bigint,WorkFlowId)
,CONVERT(datetime2,InsertDttm)
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, PeriodStartDate, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.PaymentCardStatementSummary WHERE SourceSystemcode = 'CCD'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_DELTA
AS(
    SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartDate, TGT.PeriodStartDate) AS PeriodStartDate
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode, TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
    ,CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

    FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_SRC SRC
    LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_TGT TGT
    ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
    and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
    and SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_DELTA
--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndDate = DATEADD(DAY,-1,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)))
FROM BNKM.PaymentCardStatementSummary TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
and DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
and DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
and SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'

INSERT INTO BNKM.PaymentCardStatementSummary(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,BillingCycleId
,MinimumPaymentAmount
,InterestRatePeriodInDays
,PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays
,PaymentDueDate
,LastStatementDate
,LastPreviousStatementDate
,RetailStatementBalanceAmount
,RetailStatementInterestAmount
,CashStatementBalanceAmount
,CashStatementInterestAmount
,YearToDateStatementBonusPoints
,StatementMinimumAmountDue
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.CustomerAccountId
,SRC.PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,BillingCycleId
,MinimumPaymentAmount
,InterestRatePeriodInDays
,PaymentDueDateNumberOfDays
,PaymentDueDate
,LastStatementDate
,LastPreviousStatementDate
,RetailStatementBalanceAmount
,RetailStatementInterestAmount
,CashStatementBalanceAmount
,CashStatementInterestAmount
,YearToDateStatementBonusPoints
,StatementMinimumAmountDue
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_PaymentCardStatementSummary_DELTA;

END
GO
